preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= k for x in alice_fish) and all(1 <= x <= k for x in bob_fish)
preconditions.description: All fish types in Alice's and Bob's catches are integers between 1 and k (inclusive).
Input constraints: n and m are the counts of fish caught by Alice and Bob (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 10^5), and k is the number of fish species (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(w_sum_alice > w_sum_bob for w_sum_alice in possible_alice_sums(alice_fish, k) for w_sum_bob in possible_bob_sums(bob_fish, k)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if there exists a strictly increasing sequence of weights w_1 ≤ w_2 ≤ ... ≤ w_k (with w_i > 0) such that the sum of weights of Alice's fish is strictly greater than the sum of weights of Bob's fish. Otherwise, output 'NO'.
